Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 19  
Reason for Mistake: At Step 19, WebSurfer misinterpreted the ISO 8601 timestamp from Wikidata ("+1975-08-08T00:00:00Z") as needing conversion to local time (Eastern Time, UTC−04:00). This led to an incorrect adjustment, shifting the date to August 7, 1975 instead of retaining the correct birth date, August 8, 1975, as stated on reliable sources like Wikipedia. The error was subtle and plausible due to common practices in timestamp handling but ultimately resulted in an incorrect final answer.
